# AODA Alliance

> > AODA Alliance advocates for disability accessibility rights and legislation in Ontario and Canada through education, policy campaigns, and public engagement.

The AODA Alliance is a disability rights advocacy organization focused on promoting compliance with and strengthening the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and advancing federal accessibility legislation in Canada. Led by Chair David Lepofsky, the organization campaigns on election accessibility, employment standards, healthcare access, and human rights reform.

## Key Topics

- Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA)
- Disability rights advocacy
- Disability accessibility standards
- Ontario legislation
- Accessible Canada Act
- Election accessibility
- Employment accessibility
- Healthcare accessibility
- Customer service accessibility
- Ontario Human Rights Code
- AODA compliance
- David Lepofsky
- Ford Government
- Accessibility implementation

## Core Advocacy & Campaigns

- [AODA Alliance Homepage](https://www.aodaalliance.org): Main hub for AODA Alliance disability accessibility advocacy in Ontario
- [Canada – Federal Accessibility Advocacy](https://www.aodaalliance.org/canada): AODA Alliance advocacy for federal accessibility legislation and the Accessible Canada Act
- [Ontario Election Accessibility Campaign](https://www.aodaalliance.org/ontario-election): Campaign news on making Ontario elections fully accessible to disabled voters
- [Ontario Human Rights Reform – Call to Action](https://www.aodaalliance.org/ontario-human-rights): Call to action for Ontario Human Rights Code reform and enforcement barriers

## Legislative Reference & Standards

- [About Bill 118 – AODA 2005](https://www.aodaalliance.org/about-bill-118): Reference guide to AODA 2005 legislation and compliance requirements

## Education & Historical Resources

- [David Lepofsky's Captioned Lecture Series on Accessibility History](https://www.aodaalliance.org/learn-all-about-the-history-strategies-goals-and-gains-of-ontarios-disability-accessibility-movement-from-the-late-1970s-to-early-2014): David Lepofsky's captioned lecture series on Ontario disability accessibility history from late 1970s to early 2014
- [Videos](https://www.aodaalliance.org/videos): Video series on accessibility, disability rights, and Ontario legislation
- [Publications](https://www.aodaalliance.org/publications): Publications on disability rights, AODA, and accessibility by David Lepofsky

## Specific Issue Advocacy

- [Critical Care Triage – Healthcare Accessibility](https://www.aodaalliance.org/triage): Advocacy on critical care triage accessibility barriers and government implementation
- [Rick Hansen Foundation – AODA Compliance Deadline 2025](https://www.aodaalliance.org/rhf): News on AODA compliance deadline 2025 and accessibility crisis advocacy
- [Federal Election Accessibility Campaign](https://www.aodaalliance.org/adfe): Federal election advocacy campaign promoting accessible Canada pledge

## Past Campaigns

- [2016 Ontario Legislature Blitz Campaign](https://www.aodaalliance.org/2016blitz): 2016 advocacy campaign to mobilize Ontario Legislature on disability accessibility
